ground.prompt: This is the bare ground of a river: open water and pieces of its grassy banks seen from directly above: its lawns, paths and paved areas, with no buildings and no shadows. Repaint it as a cosy oil painting of a lovely summer day: visible brushstrokes and soft impasto texture, painterly but clear, warm soft daylight, rich but natural colours, lush summer greens. The open water is calm river water, painted with fine, small, even ripple strokes in close blues, alike all over: no single ripple, swirl, foam or mark that stands out, because the water repeats side by side across a whole map. Every sandy shore stays exactly where it is. Paint only the ground: no buildings, objects or shadows. Keep the exact composition: every shape, every tree and every boundary between paving and grass in the same position, size and outline, the same straight-down camera angle. Keep every big letter on a roof or on the ground, such as a green R, C or I, exactly as it is: the same letter, shape, size and colour, crisp and flat, never turned into a sign, a helipad or another letter. Do not add trees, bushes, sky or anything else. No other text, no borders.
